name: Survey Gallery
description: Full-screen horizontal gallery of captioned photos that loops endlessly with smooth wheel or touch scrolling. Clicking a photo opens a split detail view with coordinates, elevation and a short fact.
contents: Looping row of image cards with title and elevation
Small elevation sparkline along the bottom edge
Full-screen detail overlay with large image, coordinates, title, elevation and fact text
behavior: Wheel and touch drag move the row horizontally with eased smoothing and seamless infinite looping
Images zoom slightly with a bottom shade on hover
Click opens an animated detail overlay, Escape or the Return button closes it
Detail view stacks image above text on mobile and splits side by side from 768px
editableByProps: Items with images, titles, elevations, coordinates and facts
All colors, card width, gap and scroll smoothing
Header label, return label and elevation suffix

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the sparkline look or remove it

fixed: Takes over page wheel scrolling with preventDefault while the gallery is shown, so it should be the only scroll handler on the page
Loads Fraunces, Inter and IBM Plex Mono from Google Fonts
Detail overlay is fixed to the full viewport
